messages:
Jack (Sales): Solstice Labs ping — they want to run an open 15B model in APAC for pilot. Asking: can we make `xGLM-15B-open` available in `ap-southeast-1`, and pin them to `v1.3`? They also requested a quantized variant and explicit data residency, needs SLA. Link to request: https://jira.redwood/REQ-789 (customer-provided).

Maria (Product): @Jack can you confirm estimated ARR for the pilot and whether this is blocking a contract? helps prioritization. Also any compliance constraints (SOC2/PDR)?

Jack (Sales): Pilot is pre-paid for 3 months, ~50k USD ARR if converted. Customer says regulator requires all inference to stay in APAC region.

Nora (Catalog): License check: `xGLM-15B-open` uses Apache-2.0 variant — OK to host. Need the model artifact hash + quantization recipe. @Liam can you confirm support for our quantized runtime?

Liam (Eng): runtime supports 8-bit quantized path for this arch, but we haven't benchmarked with `ap-southeast-1` capacity constraints. Current inference fleet in APAC is at ~85% for 15B-class during peak. Fallback routing to `eu-west-2` possible but would violate their residency requirement.

OnboardBot: Intake created by Jack — ticket #catalog-intake-1876543210. Please attach model bundle and eval prompts.

Maria (Product): Ok — two risks: (1) capacity in APAC, (2) quality regressions from quantization/version pin. Launch criteria proposal: successful run of our eval harness (pass quality threshold), capacity commitment or dedicated pool, and KMS audit for data residency. Thoughts?

Liam (Eng): Agreed. For immediate triage: we can do a short benchmark using a small dedicated GPU instance (1 node, 8xA10G) in APAC to estimate perf and cost. If they commit to reserved capacity (monthly), we can allocate a dedicated pool.

Nora (Catalog): I'll need the exact model tarball and a `model-card.md` with intended tokenizer, medatags (PII?), sample prompts. Jack — can you get Solstice to push that to the S3 share?

Jack (Sales): I'll request the artifact and push the contract terms about reserved capacity. They said they can sign a 6-month reserved commitment if we guarantee within-region hosting.

Maria (Product): Prioritization: Recommend P1 for onboarding flow (pilot-critical) but P2 for full cataloging until we validate quantized quality. Proposal: P1 action items this week: (a) Liam: run quick perf+quality in APAC smoke test (due +72h), (b) Nora: license & model-card checklist, (c) Jack: get artifact + contract confirmation. If all green -> create rollout plan with canary in a single AZ.

Liam (Eng): I'll schedule the smoke test. Need model bundle URL and example prompts (10).

Nora (Catalog): Checklist created in docs: https://confluence.redwood/catalog-onboard-checklist. I'll attach after Jack provides bundle.

Jack (Sales): Got it — I'll push for artifact now, and update the Jira.

Maria (Product): Thanks — I'll mark intake as "customer-pilot" and loop in infra/sales-ops for reserved capacity pricing. If anyone spots additional blockers call out ASAP. :thumbsup:

Liam (Eng): Quick note — if quantized outputs differ too much, fallback to float32 hosted variant with signed NDA might be a compromise (but cost higher).

Jack (Sales): Noted. Customer open to tradeoffs but strict on APAC. Will update by EOD.

Nora (Catalog): I'll stand by to catalog once we have the bundle.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48h for smoke test status.
